blocks.rationale: Jointly add contract-specific Illinois exemption planners for both OpenExempt views and a raw-facts airline fee calculator. The Illinois helpers correct the mistaken wearing-apparel citation and normalize asset keys, while the airline helper performs ordinal checked-bag and excess-fee calculations instead of relying on a guessed total.

inputs.question: What are the exact asset descriptions in the current Facts, excluding ownership, appraisal, price, and value language?

inputs.name: eligible_for_illinois_other_property_exemption
inputs.question: In the same asset order, which current assets are debtor-owned personal property used for personal rather than business purposes and therefore fall within the applicable Illinois exemption for any other property?

inputs.name: other_property_citation
inputs.question: What literal public citation string identifies the applicable Illinois provision exempting the debtor's equity interest in any other property?

skill.intent: Return, under the citation-only OpenExempt contract, every current personal-use asset eligible for Illinois's general other-property exemption with its literal applicable citation.

outputs.description: The citation-only native mapping from exact current asset descriptions to arrays of applicable literal citation strings.
outputs.name: answer

origin.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.

source_obligations.statement: Before assigning ordinal checked-bag positions, apply at most one current personal-item allowance and one current carry-on allowance using the stated per-dimension limits.

origin.quote: All published bag fees apply at each check-in location and are base rates according to travel dates and destination; applicable taxes are not shown.

source_obligations.statement: Select checked-bag, oversize, overweight, and standard-weight values from the detailed rows matching the current route and cabin.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: For every checked bag, add its ordinal base fee and only the higher applicable oversize or overweight fee.

source_provenance.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.
The total size of your carry-on, including the handles and wheels, cannot exceed 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm) and must fit in the sizer at the airport.
We calculate the size limits of your bag by adding the total outside dimensions of each bag, length + width + height.
For First / Business, weight is 70 lbs / 32 kgs for complimentary bags and 50 lbs / 23 kgs for excess charged bags
More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size. The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.
